title: Sir Edward Stafford to [Walsingham], 9 November 1586 (BL Harley MS 1582 ff. 76-77; DECODE R8504)

steps.what: R8504 images fetched with the R8500 siblings.
Clear holograph letter, f. 76r; one cipher word on line 2; f. 77 blank.
CSP Foreign XXI pt 1, Nov 1586: only a different 9 Nov letter to Burghley; this one not calendared.
Applied harley1582r8500 key: E=p x=i h=n 6=e II=s; Pi and rho by context r, c: princes.

outcome.method: key recovered based on adjacent plaintext
outcome.method_basis: The single seven-sign word ('princes') was read with the Stafford-Walsingham key rebuilt in harley1582r8500 from the f. 72r decipherment (R8501) and R8502 glosses in the same volume, two values taken from context.
outcome.notes: Single word read; two sign values from context.

prior.where: Not on the page; not in CSP Foreign XXI pt 1 (Nov 1586)
